sourceSentences: Crushing Blow's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds whenever Wukong or his Warrior Trickster damage an enemy.
Crushing Blow basic attack resets Wukong's and his Warrior Trickster basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.
Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
It can also gain the effects of Crushing Blow and Nimbus Strike bonus attack speed, and casts Cyclone whenever Wukong does.
Wukong can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
Turret shots instantly kill the clone.
Crushing Blow can be cast during the dash.
Casting Nimbus Strike interrupts the attack windup of enemies targeting Wukong.
Cyclone will not knock up enemies who were already hit by either Wukong or his Warrior Trickster within the same cast.
Blocking the knock up will still grant immunity to it from either of Cyclone's casts.
For combos, your go-to is to E into W then attack into Q so both you and your clone are attacking.
every time he or his clone attacks an enemy, it's reduced by 0.5 seconds
if you press E and then W, your clone will gain attack speed
you always want E before W because that way both you and your clone will get a bonus to attack speed
when you're chasing them, you want to go to E auto auto Q alto. Then you want to switch to W auto Q al.
you can hide around the corner and go W, E, auto, auto, Q, alt, and then you go auto, Q, alt.
one way is to leave a clone on one target, and then use the ultimate to apply them all there
